management_steps.details: Toxic dose: 150mg/kg or > 10g in adults. Measure paracetamol level at >= 4 hours post ingestion. Check blood gas, U&E, salicylate level.
(1) 100mg/kg in 200ml 5% Dextrose IV over 2 hours, then (2) 200mg/kg in 1L 5% Dextrose IV over 10 hours.
(1) 150mg/kg in 200ml 5% D-5-W over 1 hour, (2) 50mg/kg in 500ml over 4 hours, (3) 100mg/kg in 1L over 16 hours.
